culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Mika Miura. She wanted to seek revenge after he dumped her when they were estranged because she tried to make him eat crab to which he was allergic. She decided to use that same food which made her boyfriend go away to kill him by putting it inside cookies which he ate.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Mika Miura。她想要复仇，因为两人疏远时他甩了她，起因是她试图让他吃螃蟹，而他对螃蟹过敏。她决定用当初让男友离开的那种食物来杀他，把它放进饼干里让他吃下。
resolution.en: The culprit is Mika Miura. She wanted to seek revenge after he dumped her when they were estranged because she tried to make him eat crab to which he was allergic. She decided to use that same food which made her boyfriend go away to kill him by putting it inside cookies which he ate.

summary.en:
Sonoko, Ran, and Conan are going to a "glamping park", a luxury camping, when they witness a murder.

Location: Okuhoku Glamping Park

Victim: Keidai Tosaki

suspects: Kyoko Tosaki, Hiroshi Tanabe, and Mika Miura
